vocabulary.BLOCKED_ON_PROTECTED_WINDOW: protected-required, and the window is not available
vocabulary.PROTECTED_SCHEDULER_CAPABLE: the resident can recognize, inspect, decide, park, and continue; proven by driving that path against real contamination and real lease state
vocabulary.PROTECTED_WINDOW_AVAILABLE: contamination_class == QUIESCENT AND a proven HCLI holder pid, observed read-only. This sidecar's gpu_authority is not an input
vocabulary.REFUSED: undeclared or forbidden resource_class; no guess from the unit name
vocabulary.RUNNABLE: the scheduler would allow the unit given current (or injected) window inputs
